question: 88 tube lights were purchased for ₹88, and 46 tube lights broke in transit. The trader sold the remaining tube lights at ₹3.10 each. Find his profit.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total cost price (CP) of the tube lights = ₹88

Remaining tube lights to be sold = 88 − 46 = 42

Total selling price (SP) of remaining lights = 42 × 3.10 = ₹130.20

Profit = SP − CP = 130.20 − 88 = ₹42.20

**∴ The correct answer is ₹42.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total tube lights purchased = 88

Total Cost Price (CP) = ₹88

Number of broken tube lights = 46

Selling Price (SP) of 1 remaining tube light = ₹3.10

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Total Selling Price (SP) − Total Cost Price (CP)

 
 
 CP = ₹88
 
 
 
• 
 

 
 
 
 42 remaining
 @ ₹3.10 each

 
 (46 broken)
 

 
 
• 
 

 
 
 SP = ₹130.20

 
 

 

 Profit = ₹42.20

**Calculations:**

⇒ Number of tube lights left for sale = 88 − 46 = 42

⇒ Total SP = 42 × 3.10

⇒ Total SP = ₹130.20

⇒ Profit = 130.20 − 88

⇒ Profit = ₹42.20

**∴ The correct answer is ₹42.20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit

Profit occurs when the Selling Price (SP) of an item is greater than its Cost Price (CP). The formula is Profit = SP − CP.

Loss

Loss occurs when the Cost Price (CP) is greater than the Selling Price (SP). The formula is Loss = CP − SP.

Profit / Loss Percentage

Profit or loss percentage is always calculated based on the total Cost Price. Formula: Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.
